title: Weak convergence order of stochastic theta method for SDEs driven by time-changed Lévy noise
summary: This paper studies the weak convergence order of the stochastic theta method for stochastic differential equations (SDEs) driven by time-changed Lévy noise under global Lipschitz and linear growth conditions. In contrast to classical Lévy-driven SDEs, the presence of a random time change makes the weak error analysis involve both the discretization error of the underlying equation and the approximation error of the random clock.
